description: Find UK pharmacies that dispense a clinic's prescription, nearest first with `near`, filtered by delivery, collection or rating. Never stock or medicine prices. Example: {"near":"M1 1AE","delivers":true}

near.description: UK postcode or town; nearest first.

page.description: 60-row window; the answer says when there is another.

name: find_pharmacies

directoryTotal.description: The whole directory, when the tool read one window of it

page.description: Which window of 60 directory rows this answer read

distanceMiles.description: Miles from `near`; null when no place was given

rating.description: Published patient reviews; null when there are none

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find dispensing pharmacies
